decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The beam angel of the lamp optical control should not be greater than 60 degrees, the front glass elevation of the floodlight should be kept horizontal or a cowl fitted to prevent light trespass.
Condition : 2 - 2.	The level of illuminance should be no more than 15 lux spill outside the site boundary within 1m and no more than 6 lux spill lighting over 1m
Condition : 3 - 3.	The beam angle of the floodlight must not be visible to highway users.

Condition : 4 - 4.	The design should not exceed the following light limitations for sky glow of 5 Lux ULOR 5 (max) for installation. For intrusive light of 10 lux for vertical measured light into windows. For glare towards onlookers of 30 lux (source intensity (max per floodlight)(kick).
description: Following approval for demolition of existing buildings and erection of part single storey, part two storey building for new car show room with associated offices, valeting facilities and display parking spaces, details submitted pursuant to Condition 4 (external lighting) of approved permission dated 08/02/2000.
